title: AFCS: Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis for Factual Knowledge Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.20086v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synthetic data is increasingly used in language-model pretraining. Existing knowledge-corpus synthesis pipelines, including WRAP and Nemotron-CC, usually take a source passage or document segment as input and generate rewritten or QA-style samples from that text. This can improve surface form and prompt diversity, but it does not explicitly require fine-grained source facts -- especially secondary entities, list/table entries, and precise temporal attributes -- to appear in the synthesized corpus. We propose AFCS (Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis), a pipeline that first extracts source-supported atomic facts and then uses each retained fact to drive generation. AFCS uses structure-aware extraction over the document tree, source-grounded verification, local context expansion, and multi-format generation. In continued-pretraining experiments with OLMo-3-7B and a 32B base on the same FineWiki source corpus, AFCS outperforms WRAP and Nemotr

translated_title: AFCS：面向事实知识预训练的原子事实条件化合成
translated_abstract: 合成数据在语言模型预训练中的应用日益增多。现有的知识语料库合成流程，包括 WRAP 和 Nemotron-CC，通常以源段落或文档片段为输入，从该文本生成改写或问答式样本。这种方式可以提升表层形式和提示的多样性，但并未明确要求细粒度的源事实——尤其是次要实体、列表/表格条目和精确的时间属性——出现在合成语料库中。我们提出了 AFCS（原子事实条件化合成），一种先抽取源文本支持的原子事实、再利用每条保留的事实来驱动生成的流程。AFCS 采用了基于文档树的结构感知抽取、源文本验证、局部上下文扩展以及多格式生成。在使用 OLMo-3-7B 和一个 32B 基础模型、基于同一 FineWiki 源语料库的继续预训练实验中，AFCS 的表现优于 WRAP 和 Nemotron-CC。
tldr: AFCS 提出先从源文档抽取有据可依的原子事实、再以每条事实驱动多格式语料生成的方法，在 OLMo-3-7B 与 32B 模型的继续预训练实验中事实性优于 WRAP 和 Nemotron-CC。
en_tdlr: AFCS is a synthesis pipeline that first extracts source-supported atomic facts and then conditions multi-format generation on each retained fact, outperforming WRAP and Nemotron-CC in factual knowledge pretraining with continued-pretraining experiments.
